ApplicationPlacementSpec.description: ApplicationPlacementSpec is where an application runs.

constraints.description: Constraints use Swarm syntax (node.labels.disk==ssd); an empty list clears them, omitting keeps them.

location.description: Location defaults to the stack, a mounted volume or referenced databases, else the workspace default; fixed once created.

ApplicationSpec.description: ApplicationSpec Digest is written by CI; GitOps converges runtime to it.

containerLabels.description: ContainerLabels reserved keys (io.miabi.*, com.docker.*) are stripped on apply rather than rejected.

deployment.description: Deployment is how the app runs and how a new release replaces the running one.

externalLabel.description: ExternalLabel is platform-wide unique; a claimed one is ignored for a generated label.

healthcheck.description: Healthcheck gates releases so a broken one never replaces a working one; omitted keeps the current check.

registry.description: Registry empty means an anonymous pull; an undeclared name resolves against existing workspace credentials.

reloadPolicy.description: ReloadPolicy "restart" (default) redeploys on config change; "none" suits apps that watch their own config.

runAsUser.description: Deprecated: use security.runAsUser. Still accepted; setting both is an error.

secretEnv.description: keys stored encrypted; vault references need none, apply-resolved credentials are added

security.description: Security is checked on apply the way the console checks it.

source.description: Source and image are mutually exclusive: an app either builds or pulls.

stack.description: Stack optionally names the owning Stack resource.

strategy.description: Deprecated: use deployment.strategy. Still accepted; setting both is an error.

BackupScheduleSpec.description: BackupScheduleSpec Schedule is hourly, daily, weekly or a cron expression; presets get a per-database minute so runs spread out.

enabled.description: Enabled false removes the schedule this manifest declared.

CapabilitiesSpec.description: CapabilitiesSpec changes the Linux capabilities a container starts with. The CAP_ prefix is optional.

add.description: Add refuses anything off the allow-list on apply rather than dropping it.

drop.description: Drop removes capabilities from the default set. ALL removes every one, leaving only what add grants.

ConfigSpec.description: ConfigSpec values are interpolated like env, so a config can carry a rendered database password.

delimiters.description: Delimiters must be exactly two distinct entries.

mode.description: Mode is the default octal file mode applied to every key ("0644" when empty).

sensitive.description: Sensitive redacts content in API responses and diffs it by digest only.

CronJobSpec.description: CronJobSpec runs on the app's active release unless Image overrides it.

app.description: App is immutable: moving a schedule to another app is a delete and a create.

command.description: Command is the command to run, as a list of arguments (no shell).

concurrencyPolicy.description: ConcurrencyPolicy is allow (default), forbid (skip the fire) or replace (cancel the running one).

historyLimit.description: HistoryLimit is how many finished runs to keep; 0 keeps the default 20.

image.description: Image runs a different image in the app's runtime context; omitted runs the app's active release.

registry.description: Registry names the Registry credential that pulls Image. Only valid with image.

schedule.description: Schedule is a standard 5-field cron expression, evaluated in UTC.

security.description: Security pins the account runs use; omitted inherits the app's when each run fires.

suspend.description: Suspend omitted leaves the live value alone, so a console pause survives a sync.

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds stops a run that takes longer; 0 uses the platform default.

DatabaseInstanceRef.description: DatabaseInstanceRef is auto (reuse a compatible instance, else provision), dedicated (always provision) or shared (must exist).

name.description: Name targets one instance and makes the logical database's name exact instead of suffixed on a clash.

DatabaseInstanceSpec.description: DatabaseInstanceSpec declares an instance for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or MongoDB; Redis and libSQL are declared as a Database.

adopt.description: Adopt takes over an existing instance no manifest owns; a name match alone is refused.

placement.description: Placement is where the instance is created. Fixed once created.

recoveryPoints.description: RecoveryPoints schedules sealed sets of every database on the instance (Enterprise, S3 target required).

storageClass.description: StorageClass is immutable, so apply refuses an edit; omit it to keep the manifest portable across installs.

version.description: Version changes upgrade the instance in place or by dump and restore; a downgrade is refused.

DatabasePlacementSpec.description: DatabasePlacementSpec also accepts the old string form (placement: dedicated) as instance.

location.description: Location names where the database is created; omitted, the workspace default. Fixed once created.

DatabaseResourcesSpec.description: DatabaseResourcesSpec memory accepts Ki/Mi/Gi, CPU is cores ("0.5"); "0" removes a limit.

size.description: Size names a database size the platform offers (Enterprise), instead of memory and cpu.

DatabaseSpec.description: DatabaseSpec requests a logical database on a DatabaseInstance.

backup.description: Backup schedules logical backups to the workspace backup target; omitted keeps what it has, enabled: false removes it.

instance.description: Instance is a mode string (auto, dedicated, shared) or {type, name} naming the instance; the name is fixed once created.

placement.description: Placement's string form (placement: dedicated) is the deprecated spelling of instance.

readOnlyUser.description: ReadOnlyUser (PostgreSQL) grants SELECT on all tables; omitted keeps what it has, false removes it.

resources.description: Resources give the database its own instance, since a reused one runs with another's size; omitted keeps limits.

DeploymentSpec.description: DeploymentSpec is how an application runs and rolls out.

replicas.description: Replicas is 1 to 100; omitted keeps the current count, so a console scale is not undone.

runtime.description: Runtime service needs a location that runs a swarm; omitted, an existing app keeps its runtime.

strategy.description: Strategy is recreate, rolling or canary; omitted keeps the configured strategy.

update.description: Update tunes how Swarm rolls a new release of a service out.

DomainSpec.description: DomainSpec wildcard also covers *.name; ownership verification is a runtime action.

wildcard.description: Wildcard also claims every subdomain against other workspaces; it does not issue a wildcard certificate.

DomainTLSSpec.description: DomainTLSSpec also accepts the old string form (tls: acme|custom).

mode.description: Mode is the default certificate policy for routes under the domain.

GitRepositorySpec.description: GitRepositorySpec is safe to commit when the SecretRef vault entry is sealed.

auth.description: public|token|ssh (default token with a secretRef, else public)

GitSourceSpec.description: GitSourceSpec webhook secret is generated on create and never declared.

deletePolicy.description: DeletePolicy orphan (default) keeps a mistaken prune harmless; cascade tears resources down.

requireSealedSecrets.description: RequireSealedSecrets refuses a sync whose manifests carry a plaintext Secret value.

HealthcheckSpec.description: HealthcheckSpec applies only stated fields; the rest keep their current value.

command.description: Command needs a shell in the image; an http check does not.

path.description: Path is the URL path an http check requests, e.g. /healthz.

port.description: Port is the container port an http check probes. Omitted, the app's first port.

type.description: Type is http, command, image (the image's HEALTHCHECK, default) or none (not even the image's).

JobSpec.description: JobSpec never runs twice for the same commit; a failed run is not retried by the next sync.

app.description: App is the Application the command runs in. Immutable.

backoffLimit.description: BackoffLimit 0 never retries; retries start a new run, a sync never does.

command.description: Command is the command to run, as a list of arguments (no shell).

historyLimit.description: HistoryLimit is how many finished runs to keep; 0 keeps the default 20.

image.description: Image runs a different image in the app's runtime context; omitted runs the app's active release.

registry.description: Registry names the Registry credential that pulls Image. Only valid with image.

security.description: Security pins the account runs use; omitted inherits the app's.

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds stops a run that takes longer; 0 uses the platform default.

waitForDeploy.description: WaitForDeploy (onChange only) runs on the new release; a failed deploy marks the run skipped.

Meta.description: Custom metadata belongs in Labels or Annotations, never as ad-hoc top-level keys.

uid.description: UID survives restores and renames; when set it is matched ahead of name.

MiddlewareSpec.description: MiddlewareSpec Rule is the gateway type's own configuration, passed through untranslated.

paths.description: Paths empty applies the middleware to everything the route serves.

rule.description: Rule is the type's configuration, passed through to the gateway.

MountSpec.description: MountSpec attaches a managed Volume into the container filesystem.

key.description: Key makes Path that file's exact location; empty projects every key under Path as a directory.

PlacementSpec.description: PlacementSpec is where a stack or volume is created.

location.description: Location names where the resource is created; omitted, the workspace default. Fixed once created.

PortSpec.description: PortSpec exposure knobs are orthogonal: externalAccess is a public HTTPS URL, publish binds a raw node port.

externalAccess.description: ExternalAccess requires the base domain to be configured platform-wide.

name.description: Name lets a Route target the port by name instead of its number.

resources.description: Resources authored in this bundle. Each item is a full manifest document; the parser flattens them into the set.

RecoveryPointsSpec.description: RecoveryPointsSpec Schedule is hourly, daily, weekly or a cron expression, like a database backup's.

concurrency.description: Concurrency is how many databases are dumped at once; 0 is the service default.

enabled.description: Enabled false removes the schedule this manifest declared.

requireEncryption.description: RequireEncryption refuses the apply, and fails each run, while the workspace has no backup encryption.

RegistrySpec.description: RegistrySpec Password is write-only and never in a plan; rotation converges via PasswordFP.

ResourceSpec.description: ResourceSpec caps memory/CPU and requests GPUs. Empty/zero means unlimited/none.

gpu.description: GPUKind narrows the request to a vendor/model ("nvidia", "NVIDIA A100-...").

RetentionSpec.description: RetentionSpec 0 means unlimited for either rule.

RouteMaintenanceSpec.description: RouteMaintenanceSpec unset fields keep the gateway defaults (503 and a short notice).

statusCode.description: StatusCode must be 4xx or 5xx: a 2xx parked route reads as healthy to monitors and search engines.

advancedConfig.description: AdvancedConfig is raw Goma route YAML that SUPERSEDES the structured fields above.

certificate.description: Deprecated: use tls.certificate. Still accepted; setting both is an error.

maintenance.description: Maintenance omitted means serving, so removing the block resumes traffic.

port.description: Port is a container port number, or the name of one of the app's ports.

security.description: Security carries the gateway's per-route switches.

tls.description: TLS omitted serves HTTPS with a certificate issued by ACME.

tlsProvider.description: Deprecated: use tls.provider. Still accepted; setting both is an error.

RouteTLSSpec.description: RouteTLSSpec also accepts the old string form (tls: acme|custom|off).

certificate.description: Certificate serves an imported certificate instead of an ACME one.

enabled.description: Enabled false serves plain HTTP; omitted means true.

provider.description: Provider is the gateway certificate provider that issues the ACME certificate; omitted, the gateway default.

SealedSecretSpec.description: SealedSecretSpec opens only in the workspace and name it was sealed for; compared by fingerprint.

value.description: Value is the output of `miabi secrets seal`: sealed:v1:<keyVersion>:<data>. Never plaintext.

SecretSpec.description: SecretSpec generation options mirror the console generator so both mean the same thing.

minNumbers.description: Asking for a minimum of symbols implies symbols.

SecuritySpec.description: SecuritySpec omitted fields mean the container default, so removing one converges.

addCapabilities.description: Deprecated: use capabilities.add. Still accepted; setting both is an error.

capabilities.description: Capabilities adds Linux capabilities beyond Docker's default set and drops any from it.

devices.description: Devices are host device nodes exposed to the container, e.g. ["/dev/net/tun"].

noNewPrivileges.description: NoNewPrivileges false is refused under the restricted profile rather than silently overridden.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: ReadOnlyRootFilesystem leaves volumes writable, so paths like /tmp need a volume.

runAsUser.description: RunAsUser empty keeps the image user; restricted workspaces must use a non-root numeric uid or apply refuses.

buildEnv.description: BuildEnv is for the build only, not the running container; runtime env belongs in spec.env.

buildMethod.description: BuildMethod empty means auto: Dockerfile if present, else buildpacks.

builder.description: Builder and Buildpacks apply to the buildpack path only.

git.description: Git is the repository URL (https or ssh). Required.

ref.description: Ref is the branch, tag or commit to build. Empty builds the repository's default branch.

repository.description: Repository names a GitRepository in the bundle or one already in the workspace.

StackSpec.description: StackSpec groups applications into one logical unit / network.

env.description: Env is shared by every member application, injected on its next deploy; a member's own variable with the same key wins. Values interpolate like application env.

placement.description: Placement is where the stack is created. Member applications that name no location follow it.

secretEnv.description: keys stored encrypted; vault references need none, apply-resolved credentials are added

UpdateSpec.description: UpdateSpec is a service rollout: how many tasks are replaced at once, and the pause between batches.

placement.description: Placement is where the volume is created.

storageClass.description: StorageClass is immutable, so apply refuses an edit; omit it to keep the manifest portable across installs.

spec.description: An application either pulls an image or builds one from source — set exactly one of image and source.

description: A declarative Miabi resource. Manifests are strictly parsed: an unknown key is an error, not a silently ignored typo.

kind.description: The resource kind. Decides which fields `spec` accepts.

title: Miabi manifest (miabi.io/v1)
